title: The Difference Between a Guy You Know and a Brother Who Knows You
caption:
You can sit across from the same three guys every Sunday and still be a stranger to every one of them.

Knowing isn't shared location, it's shared truth. A brother is the man who knows about your worst week, not just the version of you that's easy to be proud of, and asks the follow-up question next week because he actually remembers.

"Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another." Proverbs 27:17

Nobody hands you a brother, fully formed. You get one by going first.
